description: Cigarette smoking status by New Zealand regional council from the Census (people aged 15+): counts and percentages of regular smokers, ex-smokers and people who never smoked regularly, per region and census year (2023, 2018, 2013, 2006). Answers "smoking prevalence by region", "ex-smoker share by regional council, 2018 vs 2023". Percentages are of people whose smoking status was stated. Source: Stats NZ, Census of Population and Dwellings (smoking behaviour tables). This is census self-report, not the Ministry of Health NZ Health Survey. No key needed from the caller.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own Stats NZ API subscription key (sent upstream as Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key), to run this call on your subscription instead of the operator's. Free subscription at https://portal.apis.stats.govt.nz/. Leave it unset unless you have a reason to use your own.

region.description: Optional regional council name or fragment, case-insensitive, e.g. "Waikato" or "Canterbury". Omit for all 16 regions.

year.description: Optional census year: "2023", "2018", "2013" or "2006". Omit for all.

name: statsnz_smoking_by_region
title: Statsnz Smoking By Region
